title: optimizer.plan_requested
description: Propose rewrites for the pages of a finished crawl. Published by the gateway or the orchestrator; consumed by the optimizer, which fetches the crawl (and the keyword study, if there is one) itself.

plan_id.description: Allocated by the caller so the result url is known before the work starts.

research_id.description: Optional: length and structure fixes do not need a keyword study.

pages.description: How many pages the plan covers. Each one is model tokens and work someone has to do.
